options_blocking_help.message: Cuskwam rules block durkatikag blacklist sessikwenyes. The whitelist is what stays reachable durkatikag whitelist sessikwenyes. Bundled categauies block commkwenye time skatikaks.

options_bundled_categories_help.message: Bundled lists wa commkwenye time skatikaks. Toggle a whole categauy, then open it kwa keep skatikagle sites available.

options_schedule_help.message: Kikaos start kwenye their own katikaside these wkatikadows. Strictness set here applies kwa the whole wkatikadow.

options_rules_help.message: facebook.com covers that domakatika na every subdomakatika. news.ycombkatikaatau.com covers that subdomakatika na anythkatikag under it. /youtube\.com\/shauts/ matches the full URL as a regular expressikwenye.

options_number_error_whole.message: $LABEL$ must be a whole number wa zero au greater.

LABEL.example: Minutes of site access per 30 minutes of focus

options_number_error_minute_range.message: $LABEL$ must be nakatika the suppauted mkatikaute range.

options_number_error_day_range.message: $LABEL$ must be nakatika the suppauted day range.

options_session_defaults_help.message: Njia na strictness are fixed wakati a sessikwenye starts. These are the values the start kwam opens na.

options_strictness_flexible_label.message: Bkatikagu: end the sessikwenye wakatiever you choose

options_strictness_friction_label.message: Nguvu: skwappkatikag early uses the ckwenyefigured deliberatikwenye gate

options_strictness_hard_label.message: Ngumu: no early end, tempauary site access kwenyely

options_cycle_help.message: Defaults: 25 mkatikaute focus, 5 mkatikaute break, 15 mkatikaute lkwenyeg break every 4th cycle. Mapumzikos kwenye a schedule beat break-wakati-you-feel-like-it kwa mood na focus katika study samples. The exact mkatikautes are ckwenyeventikwenye, not science.

options_cycle_default_label.message: Mzunguko focus na breaks by default

options_gate_help.message: A 10 seckwenyed wait na an explicit back-kwa-wauk butkwan measurably reduces impulse visits (field study, PNAS 2023). The lkwenyeger wait na the typed sentence roughly double the effect.

options_custom_delay_error.message: Cuskwam delay must be a positive whole number wa seckwenyeds.

options_gate_force_end_label.message: Kuweka "Ignaue timeout na end anyway" butkwan

options_credit_help.message: Tovuti access credit accrues while you focus. Both access kwa all sites na a skatikagle-site unlock spend from the same balance. You can step away at any time naout spendkatikag credit.

options_earn_rate_label.message: Dakika wa site access per 30 mkatikautes wa focus

options_streak_help.message: The streak counts days that reach the goal. One default sessikwenye keeps the chakatika alive, na a freeze kwaken repairs a missed day.

options_category_uncheck_help.message: Uncheck a site kwa keep it available while the rest wa the categauy is blocked.

options_session_complete_notification.message: Ongesha a system notificatikwenye wakati a sessikwenye completes

options_badge_countdown.message: Ongesha the remakatikakatikag time kwenye the kwaolbar ickwenye

options_privacy_website_unregistered_tit.message: Website access is granted, but blockkatikag is not active

options_privacy_website_unregistered_det.message: Chrome granted access, but Mtazamo Lock could not register its blockkatikag script.

options_privacy_website_on_detail.message: Mtazamo Lock can apply your active blockkatikag rules kwenye regular website pages.

options_privacy_confirm_local_history_bo.message: This permanently deletes full URLs, focus katikatentikwenyes, na detailed sessikwenye events from this device. It does not clear a runnkatikag sessikwenye, which keeps its katikatentikwenye na the address wa each tab it is blockkatikag. Endkatikag the sessikwenye clears the katikatentikwenye na starts a cleanup that clears every open website tab, na the cleanup removes every staued address wakati it completes.

This permanently deletes full URLs, focus katikatentikwenyes, na detailed sessikwenye events from this device, plus local-kwenyely aggregate statistics. It does not clear a runnkatikag sessikwenye, which keeps its katikatentikwenye na the address wa each tab it is blockkatikag. Endkatikag the sessikwenye clears the katikatentikwenye na starts a cleanup that clears every open website tab, na the cleanup removes every staued address wakati it completes.

options_privacy_confirm_synced_policy_bo.message: This permanently deletes remote settkatikags, block na allow lists, site access credit, streaks, na domakatika-level blocked-attempt aggregates from Chrome Sync. Local settkatikags na statistics stay kwenye this device.
